BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning state contracts with veteran-owned businesses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to state contracts with veteran-owned businesses; and amending RCW 43.60A.200, 28B.10.024, 39.04.162, 39.26.240, and 39.26.245.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 43.60A.200 and 2010 c 5 s 4 are each amended to read as follows:Awards of procurement contracts by state agencies to veteran-owned businesses.
BillSection.P: (1) State agencies are encouraged to award three percent of all public works and procurement contracts that are exempt from competitive bidding requirements under RCW 43.19.1906(2) of goods and services to veteran-owned businesses certified by the department under RCW 43.60A.195.
(a) Perform outreach to veteran-owned businesses in collaboration with the department to increase opportunities for veteran-owned businesses to sell goods and services to the state; and
(b) Work to match agency procurement records with the department's database of certified veteranowned businesses to establish how many procurement contracts are being awarded to those businesses.

RevNote.NoteP: *Reviser's note: RCW 43.19.1906 was repealed by 2012 c 224 § 29, effective January 1, 2013.

AnnNote.NoteP: Purpose—Construction—2010 c 5: See notes following RCW 43.60A.010.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. RCW 28B.10.024 and 2010 c 5 s 7 are each amended to read as follows:Awards of procurement contracts to veteran-owned businesses.
BillSection.P: All procurement contracts entered into under this chapter on or after June 10, 2010 the effective date of this section, are subject to the requirements established under RCW 43.60A.200.

AnnNote.NoteP: Purpose—Construction—2010 c 5: See notes following RCW 43.60A.010.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 5. RCW 39.26.245 and 2010 c 5 s 6 are each amended to read as follows:Awards of procurement contracts to office of minority and women's business enterprises.
BillSection.P: (1) All contracts entered into and purchases made, including leasing or renting, under this chapter on or after September 1, 1983, are subject to the requirements established under chapter 39.19 RCW.
(2) All procurement contracts entered into under this chapter on or after June 10, 2010 the effective date of this section, are subject to the requirements established under RCW 43.60A.200.
